description: This file is a shell script that contains a comprehensive test suite for verifying the functionality of parallel checkout operations in a Git repository management context. It sets up various repositories and branches, tests checkout behaviors under different configurations, and validates the correctness of parallel processing, submodule handling, symlinks, and filtering by comparing resulting working trees and output logs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case with a descriptive name that expects success if the embedded commands execute correctly.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite, performing cleanup and finalization.

methods.name: set_checkout_config
methods.description: Configures parallel checkout parameters such as number of workers and threshold.

methods.name: test_checkout_workers
methods.description: Performs a checkout operation with specified worker count and checks expected behavior.

methods.name: verify_checkout
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of checkout results, including file contents and structure.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates symbolic links across files or directories for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository or subdirectory.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a regular file.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a directory.

methods.name: test_stdout_line_count
methods.description: Verifies the number of lines in the standard output matches expectation.

methods.name: test_oid_to_path
methods.description: Converts a git object ID to its corresponding path, used for cleanup.
